narrative: - Dave - 2008 we welcomed another new owner for this team. Dave comes to us from Norfolk, Virginia and has been playing for about 5 years. Ugh, failed again. He lasted 1 season too. He managed to go 2-17, beating only Leto and Oak Ridge. He set the record for Least Wins in a season until Creston broke it in 2018. Congrats to you!
